notes: Read all 187 source lines line by line before editing. The hook is two halves: (A) a pure, portable web-push preference store + setPrefs updater (web L13-37, L76-87, L186) which ports 1:1, and (B) two SSE→delivery useEffects (web L89-184) that fire browser OS Notifications + WebAudio sound cues — structurally unavailable on React Native because every primitive they stand on is browser-only and absent from the native parity manifest. The native port preserves (A) verbatim (state names prefs/setPrefsState/setPrefs intact) and surfaces (B) as an explicit, consumable unavailable-delivery status, mirroring usePush.ts (kept server contract, dropped browser Notification/sendNotification lifecycle), useDirtyForm.ts (dropped the browser-only effect, kept the portable part) and useAchievementUnlocks.ts (realtimeStatus/unavailableReason explicit-unavailable shape).

L1 `import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react'` -> `import {useCallback, useState} from 'react'`: useEffect dropped because the only two effects were the SSE delivery effects, which are not wired on native (no document.hidden / Notification / AudioContext / ported sseManager). useState backs the preserved `prefs` state; useCallback backs the preserved `setPrefs`. L2 `import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'` REMOVED — web-parity has no router; the OS-notification click→deep-link is dropped exactly as AchievementUnlockListener.tsx drops its /lifetime navigate. L3 `import { sseManager } from '../lib/sseManager'` REMOVED — the browser EventSource singleton has no ported module; the native SSE precedent (useAchievementUnlocks.ts / sseClient.ts) guards on a global EventSource polyfill and reports 'unavailable' when absent (the RN default). L4 `import { useWebPush } from './useWebPush'` REMOVED — its native parity (api/hooks/usePush.ts) is server-contract-only and documents that the browser Notification permission gate + sendNotification() has no native implementation. L5 `getAlertDrillthroughHref` and L6-10 `notificationSound` (getNotificationSoundPrefs / mapNotificationToCategory / playNotificationSound) REMOVED — both are unconverted browser-only sibling modules (URL/route + WebAudio/localStorage) not in the native manifest; not inlined, matching the usePush/useDirtyForm precedent of documenting unconverted siblings as out of scope. L11 `import type { Alert } from '@/api/types'` REMOVED — it was only used to build the drill-through Alert object (web L109-121) which is dropped with navigation.

L13 `const PREFS_KEY = 'teslasync-web-push-prefs'` preserved verbatim. L15-18 `export interface WebPushPreferences { alerts: boolean; exportStatus: boolean }` preserved verbatim (only native prettier semicolons). L20-23 `DEFAULT_PREFS = { alerts: true, exportStatus: true }` preserved verbatim.

L25-33 `loadPrefs()`: the `localStorage.getItem(PREFS_KEY)` read -> `prefsStore.get(PREFS_KEY)` where prefsStore is a module-scoped `new Map<string,string>()` — the in-memory localStorage analogue established by useKioskMode.ts / useVehiclePaint.ts. The `if (!raw) return DEFAULT_PREFS`, the merge-over-defaults `{...DEFAULT_PREFS, ...JSON.parse(raw)}` (cast `as Partial<WebPushPreferences>` to match the useKioskMode cast precedent), and the try/catch graceful fallback to DEFAULT_PREFS are all preserved. Only cold-restart persistence is lost — documented in the file header + here. L35-37 `savePrefs(prefs)`: `localStorage.setItem(PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs))` -> `prefsStore.set(PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs))`, signature and JSON serialization preserved.

L39-53 `interface AlertEventData` preserved verbatim (all 13 optional snake_case fields: id/title/message/severity/vehicle_name/vehicle_id/rule_id/rule_signal/rule_severity/type/created_at/quiet_suppressed/is_test) — promoted from local to `export interface` so it stays lint-clean (no-unused-vars treats exports as used) while documenting the SSE payload contract the dropped delivery effect consumed. L55-60 `interface ExportStatusData` (status/filename/format/error) likewise preserved as `export interface`.

L62-75 the file/hook JSDoc (purpose: SSE alert/export_status → browser Notification only when document.hidden; the available backend SSE event-type list; the charge_complete/drive_end caveat) is preserved and restated for native in the file header: the document.hidden 'avoid doubling in-app toasts' gate, the alert/export_status event types, and the rationale that native cannot raise the OS Notification are all captured.
